title: Chapter 1868: Mansion Water And Inferior Water (II)

Chapter 1868: Mansion Water And Inferior Water (II)

Fierce winds howled beneath heavy black clouds.

The vast, open lands of Qi overlooked Jianghuai from the north and had been strategically important throughout the ages. Yet under the present Great Zhao, the territory promised to the Gao Family lay fragmented and incomplete.

Yan occupies the east; Zhao governs the west; and the crucial central region around Dayang Mountain is held by Buddhist cultivators. The Gao Family received only the eastern portion. Though they are Qi's foremost clan, their position is far from favorable...

Looking over the gloomy land as he flew onward, the man silently shook his head.

Their only good fortune is the Yue Cultivating Sect's [Profound Truth Mountain] in southern Qi. Though the sect has withdrawn from worldly affairs, it still controls considerable territory, forming a natural barrier between the Gao Family and Jianghuai. That is what gives them some freedom to act...

Wind and rain swept through the normally peaceful prefectural city, shrouding it in gloom. The man arrived on a streak of profound light and stopped in midair.

A man in golden robes immediately approached and said softly, "Senior Tuoba, forgive me for not coming farther out to welcome you!"

"

Ah

, Yingge... It has been quite a few years!"

The man riding the profound light was none other than Grand Daoist Master Tuoba Qiye, the King of Dai's own brother, who had gone to Luoxia to meet Yao Guanyi!

Despite the Grand Daoist Master's friendly tone, Shilou Yingge remained inwardly wary. He smiled. "Knowing you were coming, Grand Daoist Master, our king has been awaiting you for some time."

The two Purple Mansion Realm cultivators descended one after the other toward a palace wreathed in surging True Fire. Golden light shone everywhere, and vermilion gates stood open in succession. After passing through four halls, they came to a silver platform adorned with ascending dragons and twelve broken pillars, all bathed in brilliant colors.

A man sat upon a throne blazing with True Fire. He wore a snow-white upper garment and a vivid red robe, his imposing frame complemented by a fine beard and thick brows.

This was the Bolie King, Gao Fu!

Several layers of roaring flame blazed behind him, illuminating his surroundings and making him resemble a deity. He had already crossed the Purple Mansion Threshold and become a Grand Daoist Master of True Fire!

Tuoba Qiye regarded him quietly. "Congratulations!"

Gao Fu looked at him with eyes turned vivid red by the flames and replied calmly, "Nearly seventy years after you, fellow Daoist. What is there to celebrate?"

Shilou Yingge had already withdrawn to the side. Tuoba Qiye chuckled and clasped his hands behind his back. "My Tuoba Family follows the Great Dao of Boundless Essence, with a Golden Core predecessor paving the way. How could it compare to an ordinary lineage? You shoulder the affairs of a kingdom while cultivating the Great Dao of True Fire, Bolie King. How could our circumstances be compared?"

Gao Fu gazed at him and replied, "You are too modest, fellow Daoist. How fares the King of Dai?"

Tuoba Qiye answered without reserve, "His divine abilities are perfected. He is only a step away from seeking a Golden Position."

"Is he waiting for True Essence to return to its position?"

At the Bolie King's question, Tuoba Qiye replied quietly, "Not necessarily... Whether it returns or not, my elder brother will pursue the Dao. He is merely waiting for an opportunity. There are still other paths without True Essence. He cannot let those great figures lead him by the nose... What if it never returns?"

Gao Fu stroked his beard. "I am not his equal."

A complicated expression crossed Tuoba Qiye's face. Had anyone else said this, he would have taken it for granted. Coming from Gao Fu, however, it stirred no pride in him, only conflicting emotions.

After a long silence, he said, "My elder brother often says that so many great figures are rising across the world partly because these five hundred years of peace have kept the spiritual aura favorable. It has not shifted every three or five years as it does in troubled times... But circumstances and fate also play their part. All you lack, Bolie King... is the right background and fortune. Had you lived in ancient times..."

Before he could finish, Gao Fu waved a hand from his seat. "The world has countless heroes, yet whether they can leap the Dragon Gate depends on the times. Heavenly fate does not favor True Fire. What can one person's talent change? Whether it is Xiao Chuting and Chi Buzi today, or Duanmu Kui and Si Boxiu before them, which one was not extraordinarily gifted?

"Besides... only Mansion Water can rival the difficulty of attaining the Dao through True Fire."

He smiled faintly. "I do not consider myself the equal of the great demonic beast Heavenly Pheasant, whose hidden radiance drew even the master of the Tongxin Tree to witness his attempt. If even he failed, what hope is there for a lowly cultivator like me, whose path is severed?"

Tuoba Qiye fell silent for a moment. Gao Fu left the subject of his own lineage and smiled. "So Lord Yao reprimanded you."

Tuoba Qiye's eyelid twitched. His expression darkened as he replied quietly, "It was merely a warning."

Gao Fu readily understood what he meant.

That dharma body wasn't the real issue. The Tuoba Family has been meddling and scheming for all these years. Yao Guanyi merely used it as a pretext to warn them!

The Bolie King rose and slowly descended the steps. Looking at Tuoba Qiye, he asked, "In that case, what brings you to my Gao Family, Fellow Daoist Tuoba?"

Tuoba Qiye remained silent for a long while before speaking. "Dai State will take a greater part in these affairs from now on. I will lead men to Yunzhong Prefecture to support Yan State's flank and hold the King of Wei in check when the time comes."

The gloom on his face gradually gave way to cold anger. "For now, Tuoba Ci will head south to serve as a general of Zhao State. Shengle Heaven will no longer have any say over his life or death. Your Gao Family must also send men to fight alongside him."

A cold gleam flashed through Gao Fu's eyes. He seemed unsurprised by the orders, though his smile remained. "

Oh?

So you must enter the fray as well, Fellow Daoist Tuoba? How many Grand Daoist Masters have they lined up for his highness now? Even the Crown Prince of Wei faced no more than this in his day!"

At the words 'his highness,' Shilou Yingge raised his head. Tuoba Qiye looked even more incredulous, his intended words catching in his throat. After a long moment, he said quietly, "Although Yingge acted within a grotto heaven some years ago and kept it well concealed, those great figures can see through your little schemes. Whether your injuries are real or feigned... Lotus Temple has remained unscathed only because Jinlian has someone behind him!

"And now... Now... They have sent me to inform you. Isn't their meaning clear enough?"

Gao Fu stood silent with his hands clasped behind his back. Tuoba Qiye looked at him with conflicting emotions. "Brother Gao Fu... think this through carefully!"
